summary: Master HR management with our Microsoft Dynamics 365 course. Gain essential skills to optimize HR functions and drive organizational success.
lede: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central HR Management Training shows you how to organise employee records, manage absence and qualification information, protect sensitive HR data, and prepare workforce reports. You will build practical skills in employee card setup, absence classification, skills and qualifications, permission review, and reporting outputs. You will work with a controlled sample dataset to review data quality, export records to Excel, define a Power BI reporting requirement, and map a Power Automate notification for an HR exception. The course also connects HR administration with organisational units, dimensions, approval workflows, and audit evidence, while treating broader integration architecture and advanced Power BI development at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This foundation-to-intermediate course suits professionals who maintain, govern, report on, or support employee information in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. It is suitable when you need practical system capability without advanced programming or enterprise HRIS architecture experience.
audience: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Functional Consultants
modules: HR Data Quality and Excel Controls
prerequisites: You need a working understanding of employee records, absence administration, or HR operational processes. A laptop is recommended for exercises. Access to a Business Central training environment, sample employee dataset, Excel, and a browser is useful. The course teaches configuration and operational application, while Power BI and Power Automate integration remain at requirements and workflow-design level.
